Name: Better Artisan Goods for BAGI - 1.6 assets
Author: LilietBorodina
AuthorLabel: coded by Liliet - art credit to cometkins AND SHYZIIE
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5394]Better Artisan Goods[/url] is an absolutely gorgeous mod, but it's not updated anymore and the author has given everyone blanket permission to update / remix / etc. Meanwhile, [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]Even Better Artisan Good Icons[/url] (successor of the old Better Artisan Good Icons) is a mod that makes every artisan good variation based on source have a custom icon!

The old Better Artisan Goods mod has files that you're supposed to drop into the old BAGI folder and replace the files there to have BAGI use the gorgeous BAG art style instead. However, 1.6 added new fruits and vegetables that you can make jelly, juice, wine and pickles from! So the old images didn't work anymore.

[s]Well, I opened the old BAG BAGI assets, the new EBAGI assets, photopea.com and copypasted some of the BAG BAGI icons over to fill the correct positions for new artisan goods too![/s]
[size=3]And then Shyziie messaged me and now we have all new assets not copypasted from previous options!!![/size][size=4]

[/size][color=#f1c232][size=6][b]Installation instructions:[/b][/size][/color][size=4][b]
[/b][s]
[/s]1. Install Even Better Artisan Good Icons.[s]

2. Open the Even Better Artisan Good Icons mod folder, then the "assets" folder.

3. Download this mod's .zip file.

4. Unzip it into the aforementioned "assets" folder.

5. Confirm replacing old files.[/s]

2. Install this mod AS NORMAL, manually or through the mod manager.

3. Launch the game![/size][center][/center](I didn't remove the old "file replacement" version, but it doesn't have sunflower honey and is just overall inferior)



[b]If you play with SVE[/b], here's a pack for it: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30850](EBAGI) Better Artisan Goods for Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/98036803]klhumphrey918[/url]!!
[b]If you play with RSV[/b], here's a pack for it: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30871](EBAGI) Better Artisan Goods for Ridgeside Village[/url] by the same!!!!

If you're using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22848]Better Honey Mead[/url], download the compatibility patch from optional files and extract it into the Better Honey Mead mod folder!
